rewritten_query:
WITH date_filter AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1998
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 7 AND 10
),
item_filter AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Children', 'Electronics', 'Home')
      AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 68 AND 77
),
store_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_filter d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item_filter i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_sales_price / ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 0.90 AND 1.00
),
web_catalog_customers AS (
    SELECT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_filter d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item_filter i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_sales_price / ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 0.90 AND 1.00
    UNION
    SELECT cs.cs_ship_customer_sk AS customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_filter d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN item_filter i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_sales_price / cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.90 AND 1.00
)
SELECT
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt1,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt2,
    cd.cd_credit_rating,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt3,
    cd.cd_dep_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt4,
    cd.cd_dep_employed_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt5,
    cd.cd_dep_college_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt6
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
JOIN store_customers sc ON sc.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN web_catalog_customers wc ON wc.customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE ca.ca_county IN ('Benton County','Clarke County','La Paz County','Lexington city','Power County')
  AND c.c_birth_month IN (9, 11)
  AND cd.cd_marital_status IN ('D', 'W', 'M')
  AND cd.cd_education_status IN ('Unknown', 'College')
  AND cd.cd_gender = 'F'
GROUP BY
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    cd.cd_credit_rating,
    cd.cd_dep_count,
    cd.cd_dep_employed_count,
    cd.cd_dep_college_count
ORDER BY
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    cd.cd_credit_rating,
    cd.cd_dep_count,
    cd.cd_dep_employed_count,
    cd.cd_dep_college_count
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Replaced correlated EXISTS subqueries against store_sales, web_sales, and catalog_sales with pre-aggregated DISTINCT customer-key CTEs (semi-join style), eliminating per-customer repeated evaluation of the fact-table probes.
Combined the (EXISTS web OR EXISTS catalog) condition into a single UNION-based web_catalog_customers CTE, letting the optimizer use hash joins instead of OR-of-subplans.

Hoisted the shared date_dim (d_year=1998, d_moy 7-10) and item (category/manager_id range) predicates into reusable filter CTEs (date_filter, item_filter), avoiding repeated scans and filter evaluation across the three fact-table probes (constant-folded d_moy BETWEEN 7 AND 7+3 into BETWEEN 7 AND 10).
Converted comma-style joins into explicit ANSI JOINs so join order and hash joins can be planned more reliably.
Removed the duplicate 'Unknown' value in cd_education_status IN ('Unknown','College','Unknown'), leaving the equivalent IN ('Unknown','College').
Simplified price ratio bounds 90*0.01 and 100*0.01 to constants 0.90 and 1.00.
